ideas.title: Paint the Getaway Car 🚓
ideas.hook: You just robbed a toy store and every cop in town knows your car. Pull into a hidden garage, repaint it with your own design in 30 seconds, and drive out past the roadblock hoping they don't recognise you.
core_loop: Grab loot from a shop and get a wanted level
Lose the cops long enough to reach a paint garage
Paint a new design on your car with spray tools and stickers
Drive past checkpoints; the more your car changed, the less heat you get
Spend loot on faster cars, better spray cans and new garages
ideas.twist: Cops remember your last three designs. Reuse a colour scheme and the checkpoint flags you, so you have to keep inventing new looks.
monetization: VIP spray can pack (chrome, neon, glitter)
retention: Daily wanted poster with a bonus target
ideas.why_now: Paint / create sits at 1.98 momentum with 18 new games (high confidence; Make a Cartoon! and Paint and Hide! are both new paint hits). Prison / police jumped 0.63 this week to 1.47 (Tesla Roadster Chase 6,557 CCU at 13 days old, Punch Out Of Prison 4,703). Escape / run is up 0.98 to 1.58.
ideas.differentiator: Car paint games are about looking cool. Here the paint job is your escape tool, and the cops' memory forces a new design every run.

ideas.title: +1 Vine Height 🌱
ideas.hook: You smuggled one seed into your cell. Water it and your vine grows +1 block every second. When it's taller than the wall, climb it and escape before the guard's flashlight swings back.
core_loop: Water your vine for +1 height per second (more while you hold the can)
Buy fertiliser and better seeds with escape coins
Climb when the guard looks away; get caught and drop back
Escape to unlock the next, taller prison
Rebirth for faster growth and new vine types
ideas.twist: Taller vines are easier for the guards to spot, so you balance growing fast against keeping it hidden behind laundry and posters.
ideas.why_now: Grow / farm is up 0.53 this week to 1.40 with 34 new games (high; Durian Garden 8,569 CCU at 13 days). +1 stat per action is at 2.12 with 37 new games (+1 Anime Eyes 21,245). Prison / police jumped 0.63 to 1.47 (TROLL Jail Hug Tower 7,539).
ideas.differentiator: Prison games break walls. Here you grow your way over them, and the vine itself is the +1 counter and the escape route.

ideas.title: Locked in the Freezer ❄️
ideas.hook: Your ice cream shop shift ended and someone locked you in the walk-in freezer. Your body temperature drops every second. Find warm things, solve the freezer's puzzles and get out before you turn into a popsicle.
core_loop: Explore freezer rooms while your warmth meter drains
Grab hand warmers, cocoa and heaters to refill warmth
Open locked doors with codes hidden in boxes of ice cream
Reach the exit; faster escapes earn more coins
Spend coins on coats and lights for the next chapter
ideas.twist: Something else is in the freezer with you, and it only moves when the lights flicker. Heaters keep you warm but also show it where you are.
ideas.why_now: Escape / run jumped 0.98 this week to 1.58 with 34 new games (high; Steal A Pet And Ride It! 27,419, +1 Spider Arm 17,204). Interiors are at 1.93 momentum (DONT SPLASH 47,393). Ice / fire / elements is up 0.33 to 1.55, led by Ice Cream Shop [Anomaly] 6,562 CCU at 21 days.
ideas.differentiator: Escape rooms use a timer. Here the timer is your body heat, and every warm item helps you and gives you away.

ideas.title: Draw Fireworks 🎆
ideas.hook: Draw a shape on a canvas and it becomes a firework. Launch your drawings over the town at night, and the crowd pays more for bigger, brighter and weirder shows.
core_loop: Draw a firework pattern on a sky canvas
Pick colours and fuse powder, then launch it
Crowd reacts; better shows earn more cash
Buy new powders (glitter, crackle, rainbow) and bigger launchers
Book bigger venues for bigger crowds
ideas.twist: Every night one player's show is picked for the town finale and everyone watches it, so the best creators get a server-wide spotlight.
ideas.why_now: Paint / create is at 1.98 momentum with 18 new games, spread out (high; Make a Cartoon! 6,666 CCU, Make Viral Candy! 5,314). Ice / fire / elements is up 0.33 this week to 1.55. Sell / run a shop is at 1.62 with 28 new games (Sell Fries! 20,249).
ideas.differentiator: Firework games are sandboxes where you set off presets. Here you draw every firework yourself and the crowd pays for your art.

ideas.title: Design a Dollar 💵
ideas.hook: Your town needs new money and you get to draw it. Design a bill, print it in your mint, and the more people like your design the more it's worth per second.
core_loop: Draw a bill with stamps, portraits and colours
Print it in your mint; each bill earns cash per second
Other players rate bills; high ratings raise their value
Upgrade presses, ink and vaults on your plot
Unlock bigger notes ($1 to $1,000,000)
ideas.twist: Fake bills show up in your vault. Spot the forgeries by comparing details with your own design before they lower your bank's value.
ideas.why_now: Paint / create is at 1.98 with 18 new games (high). Money / rich is at 1.79 with 55 new games (high; Sell a Million Sushi 9,268, Steal A Pet And Ride It! 27,419), down 0.25 this week but still strong. Tycoon / base building is at 1.23 with 78 new games (My Small Business 11,183).
ideas.differentiator: Money games give you cash. Here you design the cash, and your art directly sets how much it earns.

ideas.title: Rock Makeover Stand 🎨
ideas.hook: Pick up plain rocks, give them a makeover with paint, googly eyes and tiny hats, and sell them at your roadside stand. Customers pay more for the cutest and funniest ones.
core_loop: Collect rocks around the map (rarer shapes deeper in)
Decorate them at your workbench
Price them and put them on your stand
Customers buy; trending styles pay extra
Upgrade your stand, tools and rock fields
ideas.twist: Each day customers want a different style (spooky, sporty, royal). Match it and they pay double, so you keep changing what you make.
ideas.why_now: Sell / run a shop is at 1.62 with 28 new games, spread out (high; Sell Fries! 20,249, My Small Business 11,183). Stones / rocks / ores is at 1.75 with 14 new games, up 0.12 this week (Cut a Rock 14,486). Paint × stones is the second-best gap in the data (score 5.5).
ideas.differentiator: Rock games are about mining or smashing. Here rocks are blank canvases, and your shop's success depends on your designs.

ideas.title: Outrun the Cave-In ⛏️
ideas.hook: You dug too deep and the mine is collapsing. Sprint up the tunnels as rocks fall behind you. Grab the ores you mined on the way, but every ore in your bag makes you slower.
core_loop: Mine ores at the bottom while the timer runs
Cave-in starts; run up the tunnels
Break through blocked spots with your pickaxe
Cash in the ores you carried out
Buy bigger bags, faster boots and stronger pickaxes
ideas.twist: Players who escape can drop ropes for others still running, and carrying a friend's ore out splits the cash.
ideas.why_now: Escape / run is up 0.98 this week to 1.58 with 34 new games (high). Stones / rocks / ores is at 1.75 with 14 new games (high; Cut a Rock 14,486, steal a strange egg 7,232). Break / mine / dig is at 2.27 but low confidence because Break and Steal an Egg holds 74% of its new-game CCU, so it is only the side mechanic here. Linear courses are at 1.89.
ideas.differentiator: Mining games are calm and escape games have nothing to keep. Here the loot you carry is what slows you down.

ideas.title: Giant's Lost and Found 🔍
ideas.hook: Giants walk past your village every day and drop things: a button as big as a house, a coin you can stand on, a lost earring. Find them, haul them home and run a lost-and-found museum that earns cash per second.
core_loop: Follow a giant's path and look for dropped items
Haul items home with carts, cranes and friends
Display them in your museum; each earns per second
Fill the index of every item from every giant
Return rare items to giants for big rewards
ideas.twist: A giant sometimes comes back for its lost item. Hand it over for a huge one-time reward or keep it for steady income.
ideas.why_now: Giant / huge is up 0.46 this week to 1.26 with 10 new games (high; Raise The Biggest Family 9,530, Durian Garden 8,569). Collect / index is at 1.66 with 47 new games (medium; Break and Steal an Egg 126,085, Bike For Egg! 25,041). Tycoon / base building is at 1.23 with 78 new games.
ideas.differentiator: Collect games make you hunt tiny things. Here every find is huge and hauling it home is part of the fun.

ideas.title: +1 Shoe Size 👟
ideas.hook: Every step makes your shoes +1 size bigger. Huge shoes squash obstacles and jump higher, but they also trip you on narrow paths. Run the course and see how big your shoes are at the finish.
core_loop: Walk to grow your shoes +1 size per step
Stomp through walls that need a big enough shoe
Cross narrow bridges before your shoes get too wide
Finish to bank shoe size as coins
Rebirth for faster growth and new shoe styles
ideas.twist: You can kick your shoes off to shrink back down for tight spots, but then you have to grow them again.
retention: Pet socks that add bonus size
ideas.why_now: +1 stat per action is at 2.12 momentum with 37 new games (high; [UPD🎃] +1 Venom Evolution 20,219, +1 Spider Arm 17,204). Giant / huge is up 0.46 this week to 1.26. Escape / run is up 0.98 to 1.58, and linear courses are at 1.89.
ideas.differentiator: +1 games grow a number you can't see. Here the stat is your shoes, and their size helps and blocks you on the course.

ideas.title: Dungeon Exit Inn 🏰
ideas.hook: You run the only inn at the exit of a huge dungeon. Adventurers stumble out hurt, hungry and carrying loot. Sell them stew, beds and potions, buy their loot cheap, and grow your inn into a fantasy town.
core_loop: Serve adventurers food, rooms and potions
Buy their loot and resell it at your market stall
Build new rooms: kitchen, stables, armoury
Hire NPC staff to run rooms on their own
Unlock deeper dungeon exits with richer adventurers
ideas.twist: Sometimes a monster follows the adventurers out. Defend your inn with the gear you bought, or the monster wrecks a room.
ideas.why_now: Sell / run a shop is at 1.62 with 28 new games, spread out (high; Sell Fries! 20,249, My Small Business 11,183). Fantasy / medieval is at 1.34 with 14 new games (medium; Tower Of Luck 3,983). Sell × fantasy is an open gap in the data (score 3.19), and interiors are at 1.93.
ideas.differentiator: Fantasy games make you the adventurer. Here you serve them, and the dungeon is your supplier.
